notes.title: Get 25% OFF Assassin’s Creed Shadows now!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3159330/Assassins_Creed_Shadows/]Assassin’s Creed Shadows[/url] is on sale for the first time ever on PC, with discounts of up to 25% off both the Standard and Deluxe Editions. If you haven’t visited Feudal Japan as the stealthy shinobi, Naoe or powerful samurai, Yasuke, now is the perfect time to jump in. 

A purchase of Assassin’s Creed Shadows not only gets you the game, but all the free content that has been released since launch. This includes:

[list]
[*] New free missions, including a Dead by Daylight crossover
[*] A new Critical Role-inspired Ally to recruit
[*] A new nightmare difficulty mode
[*] An expanded world alarm system
[*] Codex updates that adds character bios 
[*] A Balatro-inspired trinked for Naoe and amulet for Yasuke 
[*] …and more!
[/list]
We’ve also been listening to you, our community, and several of our post-launch updates are the direct result of your feedback, including: 

[list]
[*] Parkour improvements, which allowed players to perform height-gaining back ejects, height-gaining side ejects, a vertical ledge jumps and more
[*] The ability to keep equipped headgear on during cutscenes
[*] New Photo Mode options that added new filters, character poses and facial expressions, and an option to add ambient music to your Photo Mode creation. 
[/list]
Additionally, the development team continued the PC optimization and just added a new quality level - the Ultra Low Mode. This allows PC players with a limited GPU configuration to experience the game in better framerate conditions.

You can see the updated PC specifications below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310381/836f1f47fba0bdf27c581ad21364f669c4c9087d.jpg[/img]

There’s still a lot planned for Assassin’s Creed Shadows, and the development team will continue to develop updates based on fan feedback.

Some of the other major updates planned in the coming months in Assassin’s Creed Shadows include: 

[list]
[*] Claws of Awaji expansion, coming out later this year
[*] New Game+ mode
[*] New community feedback updates
[*] More free Animus Hub content & rewards
[*] Additional free story quests
[*] And more!
[/list]
Be sure to join the Assassin’s Creed Shadows [url=https://discord.com/invite/ac]Discord[/url] , where you can leave feedback or ideas, track bug fixes, and interact with a vibrant community that shares tips, tricks, and fun in-game experiences.

Buy Assassin’s Creed Shadows for up to 25% off during its first ever sale so you don’t miss a moment of the action.

notes.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Steam update makes it worth playing again
notes.content:
Assassin's Creed Shadows might have been pushed back, but Ubisoft's tentpole RPG and stealth series is far from silent. AC Mirage is about to hit Steam, the mysterious Hexe is still in the works, and now, without any hint or fanfare, Assassin's Creed Valhalla has gotten a significant update. Originally released in 2020, the Viking variation on Ubisoft's open-world formula is maybe the most expansive Assassin's Creed game of all time. Personally, I remain a Black Flag guy (I also like Assassin's Creed 3, despite its many flaws), but if you've never played Valhalla before, or you're a veteran searching for an excuse for another run through, a sizable new update provides the ideal reason.

notes.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Siege of Paris release date and gameplay
notes.content:
When was the AC Valhalla Siege of Paris release date? Your Viking saga continues as you go up against Charles the Fat in a resistance against the Carolingian Empire. The biggest invasion of France in Viking history, this battle took place in real life in the 9th century, and thousands of Vikings besieged Paris for months on end. While Norse raiders were unable to break down the walls and were eventually encouraged by Emperor Charles the Fat to move along to Burgundy, what happens in Valhalla's version of events is up to you.

Described by Karen Lee, senior community developer at Ubisoft Montreal, as "the most ambitious battle in Viking history," Siege of Paris takes you and your Assassin's Creed Valhalla protagonist Eivor to the titular French city following our adventures in the Emerald Isle in the Wrath of the Druids DLC. Here's everything you need to know about the AC Valhalla Siege of Paris gameplay, missions, and more that came along with the DLC's 2021 release date.
